$description: Ejadah / Sanad design tokens. The single source of truth for colour, type and shape. tokens.css is generated from this file by build-tokens.mjs; check-contrast.mjs proves every declared pair meets its WCAG threshold. Change a value here, never in a copy.

DEFAULT.use: Dark ground. The dominant colour, about 80-85% of a dark surface.

line.use: Hairlines, borders, graph edges on ink. Never text.

DEFAULT.use: The one load-bearing element: the mark's E, the key node, the primary action. At most 10% of a surface.

bright.use: Gold on ink at small sizes, focus rings, hover.

dim.use: Gold fills and strokes on light surfaces. Not for small text on ink (4.1:1).

deep.use: Gold text on paper (5.5:1). Plain gold on light fails (2.4:1).

DEFAULT.use: Primary text on ink. Cool off-white: less glare than pure white.

muted.use: Tertiary small text on ink (5.5:1). Proposed replacement for faint at body sizes.

faint.use: Large text (18px+, or 14px bold) and decoration only: 3.9:1 on ink fails body-text AA.

DEFAULT.use: Light ground: documents, print, slides, the light theme.

status.$note: The two status words (ADR-0003). Colour is never the only cue: always render the word, and 'planned' also takes a dashed outline.

diagram.$note: The Sanad picture theme (Sanad/src/design/pictureTheme.ts, SAN-SYSML-253) restated for marketing: fill = hue at 12% into the ground, stroke = hue pulled 30% toward the text colour, text = the ground's text colour. Each kind keeps its shape cue so greyscale still reads.

mono.use: Identifiers, paths, hashes, code: REQ-SYS-042, a1b2c3d.

contrast.$note: Pairs check-contrast.mjs enforces. text = 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3), large = 3:1 (1.4.3 large text), graphic = 3:1 (1.4.11). Values are token paths.
mustFail: Plain gold text on paper - use gold.deep.
Hairlines are decoration, never the only boundary of a control.
